name: flower-man
description: Flower Man: flower marketplace and delivery platform (Bergamo pilot).

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --recursive run test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --recursive run test:integration
scripts.db:check: docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml exec -T db psql -U flower_man -d flower_man -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS db_user, current_setting('server_version') AS postgres, (SELECT default_version FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name = 'postgis') AS postgis_available, (SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'postgis') AS postgis_installed, current_setting('TimeZone') AS timezone, datlocprovider AS locale_provider, datlocale AS locale FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database();"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @flower-man/api --fail-if-no-match run db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate:status: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @flower-man/api --fail-if-no-match run db:migrate:status
